name: Avatar Group
description: An overlapping identity stack with an overflow count.

anatomy.description: Overlapping Avatars with a surface ring keeping each identity separate.
A +N count for hidden members, aria-hidden because the group label already names everyone.
role="group" with an aria-label joining every name, so overflowed members are still announced.

dos: Lower max in dense contexts like table rows so the stack stays compact.
Order names by relevance; the tail collapses into the overflow bubble.
donts: Don't repeat the member list next to the group; the accessible label already exposes it.
Don't use a group for a single identity; use Avatar.

examples.title: Overflow
examples.description: Past max, a +N bubble summarizes the rest; the group label lists everyone.

examples.title: Compact overflow
examples.description: size="sm" with a low max collapses the rest into a small +N bubble.

examples.title: Compact stacks
examples.description: Use the small size and a lower max inside table rows.

guidance.useWhen: Several identities belong to one row or card.
guidance.avoidWhen: One identity needs emphasis; use Avatar.
guidance.behavior: Overflow collapses into a +N bubble; the group label names everyone.
guidance.responsive: Lower max in dense contexts like tables.

notes: The group exposes role="group" with an aria-label joining every name, so overflowed members are still announced.
The +N overflow bubble is aria-hidden; it summarizes visually without repeating the names.

apiEntries.description:
An overlapping stack of avatars with a `+N` overflow bubble. The group
exposes the full name list as its accessible label.

props.description: Names to render as avatars, in order.
props.name: names

props.description: Maximum number of avatars shown before collapsing the rest into a count bubble.
props.name: max
